acceptanceCriteria: Both tests pass when the test binary is invoked by a relative path from a different working directory (scripted reproduction retained).
One mutation (back to os.Args[0]) fails the reproduction.
body: Residual from the V1-1392/1324/1294 internal/tasks flakes lane (PR #918, branch claude/tasks-flakes-1392-1324-1294, head 887ad7cab, base 32c57367d; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). Running a compiled internal/tasks/store test binary via a relative path (e.g. ./store.test from another cwd, as sharded runs do) makes these two tests fail because they re-exec os.Args[0] after a chdir. Expected: tests resolve their own executable (os.Executable) and pass regardless of how the binary was invoked.
title: TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan and TestPSROrphanEarlyInitializationCleanup re-exec os.Args[0] and fail when the test binary runs by a relative path
